name: dashboard-editor
scenario: Build a new dashboard editor: drag-and-drop chart layout, live data binding per chart, undo/redo history, cross-component state sync between the layout grid and a chart-config side panel, and persistence of the layout schema.
signal_summary: Multiple independently verifiable subsystems (layout engine, data binding, undo/redo, persistence) with real dependency ordering between them and enough surface that one shot planning would be unreliable.
expect_reason: Distinct architectural boundaries each need their own verification before the next is planned in detail — a single phase or wave can't safely cover all of it.
